findings.quote: the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
findings.rationale: Exit fee triggered by any Company termination including ordinary non-renewal, with no carve-outs for HDI breach, measured on revenue, and non-reciprocal.

replacement.oldText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
replacement.newText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement for convenience during the initial term, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment (the "Termination Payment") equal to the fees payable under Section 3.1 for the three (3) months preceding the Termination Date, which shall be HDI's sole and exclusive remedy for such early termination and shall be subject to the Company's right of set-off; provided that no Termination Payment shall be due if the Company terminates or elects not to renew (i) upon or effective as of any anniversary of the Effective Date, (ii) for HDI's material breach (uncured for 30 days), (iii) for HDI's failure to meet the applicable service levels, (iv) under Section 1.6, or (v) upon HDI's insolvency or change of control.

findings.quote: Each Party represents and warrants to the other Party that (1) it is a corporation organized, validly existing and in goodstanding
findings.rationale: Section 9 contains only corporate-authority reps; no service performance, non-infringement, malicious code or compliance-with-law warranties, and no service levels.
No indemnities at all; review requests HDI IP, security incident and negligence indemnities.
No limitation of liability or consequential damages waiver; unlimited exposure.

findings.quote: The Uniform Resource Locator, or address on the World Wide Web for the Site ("URL") shall be as mutually agreed by the Parties and shall be established and registered as necessary by HDI at no cost to the Company.
findings.rationale: Agreement never states ownership of site design, code, domain or customer/order data; no data use restriction on HDI.
No transition assistance, data return/deletion or domain transfer on termination, aggravated by required Globix termination.

findings.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
findings.rationale: Auto-renewal with 90-day notice; unclear whether notice is convenience termination or non-renewal, which drives Termination Payment exposure.

findings.quote: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other
findings.rationale: Termination on notice is available to both parties but only the Company pays an exit fee; HDI may walk owing nothing.

findings.quote: HDI's General Manager (as hereinafter defined), may upon no less than thirty (30) days prior written notice to the Company, have the right to inspect the records of the Company's General Manager
findings.rationale: Audit by HDI's own manager (a potential competitor) rather than an independent CPA; no frequency limit, scope limit or reciprocity.

replacement.oldText: HDI's General Manager (as hereinafter defined), may upon no less than thirty (30) days prior written notice to the Company, have the right to inspect the records of the Company's General Manager reasonably related to the calculation of such payments during the Company's normal business hours. The fees incurred by HDI in connection with the inspection shall be borne by HDI.
replacement.newText: Upon no less than thirty (30) days prior written notice to the Company, and no more than once in any twelve (12) month period during the term and for twelve (12) months thereafter, HDI may cause an independent certified public accountant (who is not a competitor of the Company, is bound by confidentiality obligations and is not compensated on a contingent-fee basis) to inspect, during the Company's normal business hours, those records reasonably related to the calculation of payments under Section 3.1. The fees incurred in connection with the inspection shall be borne by HDI unless the inspection reveals an underpayment exceeding five percent (5%), in which case the Company shall reimburse the reasonable cost of the inspection. The Company shall have a reciprocal right with respect to HDI's reporting and traffic records.

findings.quote: the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products
findings.rationale: Exclusivity too broad (could bar marketplaces, affiliates, drop-ship, other leather goods) and inconsistent with the non-exclusive trademark licence granted in the next paragraph.

findings.quote: a non-exclusive, limited, non-transferable license to use the Company's "Deerskin" trademarks, service marks, and logos
findings.rationale: Trademark licence lacks quality control/approval rights, ownership/goodwill acknowledgment, prohibition on HDI registering Marks or domains, and express termination/wind-down.

findings.quote: This Agreement shall be binding upon, and shall inure to the benefit of and be enforceable by, the parties hereto and their respective legal representatives, successors and assigns
findings.rationale: Free assignment permitted; HDI could assign brand licence, customer data and exclusivity to a competitor; no change-of-control protection.

replacement.oldText: 10.3 Assignment. This Agreement shall be binding upon, and shall inure to the benefit of and be enforceable by, the parties hereto and their respective legal representatives, successors and assigns, but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
replacement.newText: 10.3 Assignment. Neither Party may assign or delegate this Agreement, in whole or in part, without the prior written consent of the other Party, except to a successor to all or substantially all of its business that is not a competitor of the other Party. In the event of a change of control of HDI, the Company may terminate this Agreement upon written notice without any Termination Payment. Subject to the foregoing, this Agreement shall be binding upon and inure to the benefit of the parties and their permitted successors and assigns, but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.

findings.rationale: No insurance requirements; review recommends CGL, professional/E&O and network security coverage with certificates.

findings.quote: This Agreement shall be governed and construed and enforced in accordance with the laws of the State of New York
findings.rationale: Governing law present but no exclusive venue, dispute resolution or jury waiver.

replacement.oldText: 10.5 Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed and construed and enforced in accordance with the laws of the State of New York applicable to contracts made and to be performed exclusively in that State without giving effect to the principles of conflict of laws.
replacement.newText: 10.5 Governing Law; Venue. This Agreement shall be governed and construed and enforced in accordance with the laws of the State of New York applicable to contracts made and to be performed exclusively in that State without giving effect to the principles of conflict of laws. The parties irrevocably submit to the exclusive jurisdiction and venue of the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York, and each Party irrevocably waives any right to trial by jury in any action arising out of or relating to this Agreement.

findings.quote: HDI shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet from which products substantially similar to Deerskin Products
findings.rationale: Non-compete runs against HDI (vendor), not the Customer; not flagged as an issue in the review.
